> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Completing more passes for more yards and touchdowns than the opposing quarterback means the team's quarterback played better. | Commonsense Knowledge

> > Fact From Story: When Cincinnati began the season 1-3, including a pair of blowout losses in which they scored just three points in each game against the Browns and Titans, it sure seemed Joe Burrow's calf injury would wind up holding the team back.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Teams that have been underperforming can return to their previous state.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Limiting the opposing team to a small number of points greatly increases the chance of winning.
